name: fullstack-saas
description: Multi-platform SaaS with a requested stack recommendation; the plan must recommend a compatible stack and cover billing, roles, and automated tests.

configuration.name: Pulse Analytics
configuration.description: SaaS analytics dashboard for small teams with workspaces, subscription billing, and a companion mobile app for alerts.

requirements.custom: Workspace owners can invite members with viewer or editor roles.

output.summary: A multi-tenant analytics SaaS: a Next.js web dashboard and a Flutter mobile app for alerts, backed by PostgreSQL, with workspaces, roles, subscription billing, and automated tests.

requirements.statement: Users sign in and belong to one or more workspaces.
Workspace owners invite members as viewers or editors.
Users view dashboards of their metrics on the web.
Users receive metric alerts on the mobile app.
Every workspace's data is isolated from other workspaces.
Automated tests run in CI for web, API, and mobile.

assumptions: Metrics arrive through a documented ingestion API.

open_questions.question: Which pricing tiers and trial terms should billing support?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Shapes the subscription model and billing integration.

open_questions.question: What metric sources must be supported at launch?

recommended_stack.rationale: Next.js serves the SEO-friendly marketing site, dashboard, and API routes; Flutter covers iOS and Android alerts from one codebase; PostgreSQL row-level security supports workspace isolation.

tasks.title: Multi-tenant schema
tasks.description: Workspaces, memberships, roles, and row-level isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-workspace reads are denied in tests

tasks.title: Auth, workspaces, and invitations
tasks.description: Sign-in, workspace switching, and role-based invitations.
acceptance_criteria: An owner invites a viewer who cannot edit

tasks.title: Subscription billing
tasks.description: Plans, checkout, and webhook-driven subscription status.
acceptance_criteria: A test subscription activates a workspace

tasks.title: Mobile alerts app
acceptance_criteria: An alert reaches a test device

tasks.title: Automated test suites in CI
tasks.description: Unit, API, and end-to-end tests for web and mobile.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs all suites on every change

required_approvals.description: Approve the tenancy and billing architecture before implementation.
